project.name: PomoTick 手表 UI
project.styleDefinitionBrief: PomoTick 番茄钟手表应用 UI，深色 OLED 友好主题，Apple 设计系统约束，1.91 英寸方形屏幕模拟
project.designRead: watch app / pomodoro timer user / restrained dark / information-dense / avoid cluttered layouts

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: Apple System Red #FF3B30 for focus phase, Apple System Blue #007AFF for break phase
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: dual-hue semantic: red for focus, blue for break, on pure black OLED background

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: restrained radius: 12-16px for cards/buttons, pill-shaped for primary CTA, circular progress ring for timer
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: DM Sans for interface, tabular/monospace for timer digits, tight tracking on display numbers
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: compact watch-first: 12-16px horizontal padding, 8-12px vertical gaps, 42-48dp touch targets
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: dark surface cards with subtle borders, large tappable areas, minimal decorative elements
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: border-first depth: 1px borders define cards, no heavy shadows on static elements
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: system icons only, no decorative imagery, functional icon-first design
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: subtle feedback, no animation flourish, immediate response to tap

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: no global nav — watch app uses screen-level navigation only
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: semantic dual-hue: #FF3B30 focus red, #007AFF break blue, on #000000 OLED black
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: DM Sans for labels, tabular monospace for timer countdown digits
sharedProjectShellContract.radiusScale: 8px small, 12px medium, 16px large, pill for buttons
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: border-first, no shadow on static cards, subtle elevation on overlays only
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: large pill buttons, 56-64dp height, full-width, high contrast
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: center-aligned single-column, horizontal padding 16dp, vertical rhythm 8-12dp

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Apple-inspired dark watch UI: OLED black background, system red #FF3B30 for focus, system blue #007AFF for break, DM Sans typography, restrained radius, border-first depth

productContext.productType: pomodoro timer for OPPO Watch 4 Pro

pages.title: 计时器
pages.businessScenario: Main timer screen showing countdown ring, remaining time, phase label, and tap/long-press actions
pages.visualNorthStar: Large circular progress ring centered on 1.91in square OLED screen, bold tabular countdown digits, minimal chrome — Apple Watch Activity Rings inspired
pages.compositionPattern: single-focus centered layout with circular progress as hero element

pages.title: 到点提醒
pages.businessScenario: Timer completion alert screen with phase-specific title, primary confirm button and secondary stop-alarm button
pages.visualNorthStar: Urgent but calm full-screen alert: bold completion title, two stacked pill buttons, subtle primary color glow background
pages.compositionPattern: centered vertical stack: title → spacer → primary CTA → secondary CTA

pages.title: 设置
pages.businessScenario: Settings screen with 6 configurable items: focus duration, short break, long break, focus cycles, vibration strength, ringtone toggle, plus permission banner and back button
pages.visualNorthStar: Compact scrollable list of setting rows with +/- controls, consistent card styling, permission status banner at top
pages.compositionPattern: single-column scrollable list with titled header, status banner, setting rows, and back button
